subject: A question of etiquette, and of money

messages.text:
Dear Luis,

I find myself in want of advice from someone under seventy.  Kirsty's fiance, Euan, has very kindly invited me on his stag weekend in Edinburgh in October.  Two nights, a ceilidh, a distillery and something called axe throwing.  The best man has sent round a budget of £385 a head, not including the train.

I should like to go to some of it, and I should like not to be the old man at the end of the table whom everyone is minding.  My late wife would have said go to the dinner, buy a round, and leave before the axes.  Is that still how it is done, or is a partial attendee a nuisance to the best man's spreadsheet?

Yours,
Hamish Fairweather

your wife was right. go to the saturday dinner, put £50 behind the bar and be in bed before the axes come out. tell the best man now so he can work out a separate price for you, they always prefer knowing early. nobody minds a partial, they mind a surprise

L

Dear Luis,

Done.  I have written to the best man, a nice young man called Fraser, and offered £120 for the Saturday dinner and my share of one night's room.  He said yes within the hour.  I think he was relieved.

Yours,
Hamish Fairweather

truth.summary: Hamish asked Luis how to join part of Euan's stag weekend in Edinburgh (budget £385 a head); Luis said go to the Saturday dinner only and tell the best man early, and Hamish offered Fraser £120 for the dinner and one night's room, which Fraser accepted.

messages.text:
Dear Luis,

Thank you for the scans that arrived on 28 September. I now have the CFDI invoices for 6 April 2025 to 5 April 2026 and the bank statements, which is most of what I asked for on 14 September.

The gap is the Mexican tax. Lupita's acknowledgement covers your annual return for calendar year 2025, but the UK tax year runs from 6 April to 5 April, so I cannot use the annual figure as it stands. There are two ways forward:

1. Lupita gives us the tax you actually paid month by month (the provisional payments) for April 2025 to March 2026, and I match them to the UK year.
2. I apportion the 2025 annual figure by time. This is quicker but rougher, and it will probably give you less credit than you are due.

I would recommend the first. Could you let me know which you would prefer?

Kind regards,

Martin Hale FCA
Hale Navarino Accountancy
3 Navarino Mews, London E8 | 020 7946 0921

Hi Luis,

I went up to the Eel & Anchor's upstairs room this afternoon with Ben and my tape measure, to measure for Jo's surprise. Photos attached, one straight on and one from the door so you can see what Jo will see first.

The wall behind the fireplace:
2.10 m wide from the corner to the window frame
1.05 m clear between the fireplace edge and the window
Mantelpiece 1.18 m high, sticks out 22 cm

There is a socket, a double, on the left at skirting height. Ben checked it with his phone charger and it works.

Now the bit that worried me. Ben says you're bringing a 140 cm screen. If that's a television, I don't think it can go on that wall. The plaster above the mantelpiece is old and crumbly (I pressed it and a bit came off, sorry pub), and the landlord said nothing gets screwed into it. A 140 cm telly on a stand in front of the fireplace would block the way through to the toilets, and someone will knock it over by ten o'clock.

Could it go on the long wall by the bar instead? It's plain and there's no fireplace, though the only socket is behind the fruit machine.

Harriet

Dalston Step Clinic, Dalston

So the fireplace wall works: the feet go either side of the hearth, the screen sits just above the mantelpiece, and it's well clear of the way through to the toilets. The projector goes on a stool by the door, plugged into that double socket. That's assuming Andrei comes through with his old one; he's gone quiet on me, so I may end up borrowing one from work.

Ben's 7:30 for 8: I'll tell him 7:45. Thirty people can hold their breath for fifteen minutes. Maybe.

L

messages.text:
Estimado Luis Cordero:

Mi nombre es Karla Benítez y atiendo la cuenta de diseñadores independientes en Litografía Corredor, en la colonia Americana de Guadalajara. Vi las bolsas de Tueste Laja y Niebla en su barra de Chapultepec y ahí me pasaron su nombre. Me llamó la atención cómo resolvió la impresión sobre kraft.

Le escribo porque trabajamos con muchos diseñadores que mandan a imprimir a nombre de sus clientes, y creemos que podemos facilitarle el trabajo con los suyos. Esto es lo que ofrecemos:

- Bolsas de café en kraft con válvula, desde 1,000 piezas, con prueba de color física incluida en el precio.
- Etiquetas en rollo para cerveza, conservas y cosmética, desde 500 piezas.
- Papelería, recetarios y señalización para consultorios y clínicas.
- Un asesor que revisa sus archivos antes de imprenta, sin costo, y le avisa por correo si algo no va a salir bien.
- 10 % de descuento en el primer pedido de cada cliente que nos recomiende.

Le adjunto nuestro catálogo 2026 y la lista de precios para diseñadores. Los tiempos de entrega van de 8 a 12 días hábiles, y enviamos a todo el país sin costo a partir de $6,000 MXN.

Sabemos que vive en Londres, pero si en diciembre anda por Guadalajara, con gusto le damos un recorrido por el taller. Muchos de nuestros clientes aprovechan esas fechas para ver pruebas en máquina.

Quedo a sus órdenes.

Karla Benítez
Ejecutiva de cuenta, diseñadores
Litografía Corredor
Av. Libertad 1840, col. Americana, Guadalajara, Jal.
33 3900 1840

truth.summary: Karla Benítez of Litografía Corredor, a Guadalajara print shop, pitched packaging and label printing to Luis after seeing Tueste Laja y Niebla's bags at its Chapultepec bar, saying she'd attached a catalogue and price list that weren't attached; no reply needed.
facts: Litografía Corredor: Av. Libertad 1840, col. Americana, Guadalajara; phone 33 3900 1840.

10% discount on the first order of each client Luis recommends; free file check before printing.
Delivery in 8 to 12 working days; free shipping in Mexico from $6,000 MXN.
